Name: TheDefective1's 1.6 Yandere Elliott Portraits
Author: TheDefective1
Description:
I made a set of portrait replacements to use with the Yandere Elliot mod, for fellow yandere Elliot enjoyers~ [u]These portraits can also technically be used without having the Yandere Elliot mod installed, but why would you though???[/u] LOL They won't make as much sense without it, so [b]I'd recommend downloading my 'medicated' version of these pngs under 'optional files' instead if you prefer the man without the baggage![/b]

To use these portraits, just drag and drop the .PNG files into the portraits folder within the Portraiture mod folder, [If you're in the right spot, the file location should look like this: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\mods\Portraiture\Portraits] and that's it!

[b]Once you're in game, go talk to Elliot and press 'P' until you see his portraits switch to this one! Then press 'O' to lock him onto that set of portraits, so that you can still change other NPCs portraits without changing his too.[/b]

I'm working on a set of portraits that will also be compatible with Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic, since I have that mod installed, but I've got a loooong way to go before THOSE are finished... 😅

Downloads.Description: 'Medicated' version of my yandere Elliot portraits! For those who prefer him WITHOUT the baggage <3 **NOTE: Downloading both versions won't work since the file names are identical to their counterparts! You'll have to pick one OR the other!
